title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 15: the useless wood of the vine, and what Yahweh says about the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

questions.text: Which tree does Yahweh ask about in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks, 'Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?'

questions.text: Where is the vine-branch said to be?
questions.explanation: The question is about the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest.

answers.text: Among the trees of the forest

questions.text: What does verse 3 ask whether men would take from it?
questions.explanation: It asks whether wood would be taken of it to make anything, or whether men would take a pin of it to hang any vessel on.

answers.text: A pin to hang a vessel on

questions.text: What is done with it, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: It is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends and the middle of it is burned.

answers.text: It is planted beside many waters
It is made into a vessel
It is left for the birds
It is cast into the fire for fuel

questions.text: Which parts of it had the fire devoured?
questions.explanation: The fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned, so it is not profitable for any work.

answers.text: Both its ends, and the middle is burned
Only its roots in the ground

questions.text: What is said about it when it was still whole?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that when it was whole it was suitable for no work, much less now that the fire has devoured it.

answers.text: It was suitable for no work
It was fit for a vessel

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh give over as he gave the vine tree to the fire?
questions.explanation: As the vine tree among the trees of the forest is given to the fire for fuel, so Yahweh will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will set against them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'I will set my face against them,' and that then they will know that he is Yahweh.

questions.text: What happens to them when they go out from the fire?
questions.explanation: They will go out from the fire, but the fire will devour them.

answers.text: They will be gathered to the land

questions.text: Why will Yahweh make the land desolate?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will make the land desolate because they have committed a trespass.

answers.text: Because they have committed a trespass
Because they refused to build the wall
Because they cut down the vineyards
